products.title: No Gi Berimbolo System Part 1 by Mikey Musumeci
products.body:
Learn The Total Technical No-Gi Guide To Taking The Back With Berimbolos From Mikey Musumeci - The Most Dominant American Lightweight Grappler Ever & Rising No-Gi Superstar - 8 Volumes Of Technique For Grapplers Of All Levels

  • Go step-by-step through every part of this highly successful back take attack, including ways to make it work even if you aren’t flexible or quick
  • Mikey Musumeci is a multiple-time IBJJF world champion in the gi who is now transitioning to no-gi grappling with incredible results
  • Mikey teaches you how to troubleshoot common problems and berimbolo situations so you can stay one step ahead
  • Use berimbolo from bottom and top to move your way to the back with twister hooks, step stomps, crab hooks, and more

Start With Basic Berimbolos And Keep Building Up Your Arsenal With Variations And Modifications You Can Use!

 

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

Start taking the back in no-gi grappling with BJJ star and multiple-time world champion Mikey Musumeci, as he shows you his signature berimbolo system across this new 8-volume instructional series. Move from the berimbolo to dominant control of the back with step-by-step technique that grapplers of all levels can use, shown in extreme detail by Mikey.

Mikey is a highly valued instructor, because of his attention to those little details that make big differences in success or value. Now he shows you how you can hunt the back like he does, even without the gripping of the gi. Use twister hooks, ladder bolos, crab hooks, and more to chain together the most effective back takes possible.

The berimbolo is a modern back take that has become a staple at the elite level, and no one has been more successful with this technique than Mikey. Now you can learn from the man himself, as he teaches how exactly how he moves through his opponents defenses and breaks down the berimbolo so that grapplers of all body types, ages, and styles can use this highly effective position.

Mikey breaks down the differences in berimbolo with and without the gi, explaining how to still find the dominant position of the back with reliable offense. With advice on troubleshooting and countering their defenses, Mikey offers you a complete masterclass on everything you’ll need to master the berimbolo.

products.title: The Berimbolo System Part 1: The Foundation by Mikey Musumeci
products.body:
3-Time Black Belt World Champion Mikey Musumeci teaches the most comprehensive berimbolo system ever - including winning details never shown before!

  • Get rid of all the myths around the berimbolo - including how grapplers of any age and level can start using this move without being super flexible
  • This 8-volume mega-series goes through all of the movements, moves, counters, and combos you need to know for a total back take attack
  • The berimbolo is one of BJJ’s most notorious back takes, and now you can find out the exact mechanics behind winning fights with it
  • Mikey is the most successful American Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu black belt ever, winning three world championships in the gi with these systems
  • Master positions like the double guard pull, the stack berimbolo, the twister hook, and more


Unlock All The Simplified Secrets of Systematic Berimbolos From Black Belt World Champion Mikey Musumeci - Including How Older, Bigger Grapplers Can Shock Their Opponents With This Attack (No Flexibility Needed)

Check out a free sample:

 

What Will You Learn?

Black belt back taking wizard Mikey Musumeci is back with BJJ Fanatics with the most expansive and complete berimbolo system ever put together. On this 8-volume series, learn all of Mikey’s favorite ways to take the back as he shows you why the berimbolo is a move anyone can use.

Berimbolos are one of BJJ’s most recognizable and notorious moves, and a lot of older, less flexible grapplers think it isn’t for them. Now that can all change. Mikey’s system is made so that it doesn’t take any crazy flexibility or speed, instead using reliable grips and simple body movements to create the attacks you want.

Across these 8-volumes, learn how to cut out all the confusion and get right to the back with this rolling technique. From top, bottom, and even Mikey’s notorious double guard pull, you can lock into this step-by-step method for exposing the back and securing your control of an opponent.

Even against way bigger, stronger fighters, you can have huge success with the berimbolo. Mikey has become notorious for fighting opponents as big as twice his size, and he does it with a deep level of understanding of technique that few can match. Now, you can benefit from his lifetime of study as he pulls back the curtain on his modern style.

Get To The Back With Systematic Control With Black Belt World Champion Mikey Musumeci’s Guide To Berimbolo Wedges & Hooks

  • Learn how to use wedges and hooks to get to the back with this newest installment of Mikey Musumeci’s berimbolo system
  • Mikey Musumeci is a multiple-time world champion and the most successful American black belt competitor ever, known for his technical wizardy and back taking skill
  • See why Mikey believes anyone can use these berimbolo strategies and techniques to get to the back, no speed or flexibility needed
  • Use crab rides, knee wedges, twister hooks, leg drags, and more for berimbolo success


Learn To Master The Berimbolo With Mikey Musumeci's Latest Edition To His Berimbolo System Where He Breaks Down How To Effectively Use Wedges & Hooks Over EIGHT Parts!

Check out a free sample:

 

What Will You Learn?

 

 Make your back takes sharper than ever as black belt world champion Mikey Musumeci shows you how to use wedges and hooks for berimbolo success. With thorough step-by-step analysis of each technique and position, Mikey explains how grapplers of any level or size can start using these strategies for success on the mat.


 

Utilize proven back taking methods like the twister hook and the crab ride, as Mikey coaches you through how to create the most control and leverage in each position. With no flexibility or athleticism necessary, start finding your way to the most dominant positions in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu using these signature systems.


Mikey Musumeci is the most successful American black belt competitor in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, winning multiple world championships and competing at an elite level his entire career. This is volume three of Mikey’s continuing berimbolo instructional series, teaching every detail of his signature technical system to share his keys to success with the jiu-jitsu world.
